candidates.authority: public discovery plus private account-bound revenue planning from user-supplied income, expense, debt, savings, skill, time, work and general-location inputs

self-reported earned revenue stays distinct from modeled opportunity revenue
private financial, employment, skill, location and progress data are not public discovery data
